notes.title: Patch Notes Vol.001
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45156462/569b64649252b7db43b183d2b9dcfcea47f119dc.png[/img]

Hello, Glass fans!

We are pleased to announce that we have patch for Glass Zero.

Tired of exiting in fullscreen and having to return to the windowed screen first?
Now you can quit the game directly from fullscreen.

It's a small patch, but we hope it helps...

Our programmer have been having a hard time getting out and about lately due to the snow.
We hope you're all staying healthy.
We'll try to stay strong and make your gaming experience more enjoyable.

Thank you.

notes.title: GLASS ZERO is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45156462/b7a6eaa4c533a62b9ba2438ed566abdfcf80fc45.png[/img]

Hello GLASS fans!

Today we have great news for you.

GLASS ZERO is here!

A happy life with a childhood friend. But a mysterious woman suddenly appears!

Exciting choices and thrilling developments!

This is a romance simulation game that gives you a glimpse into the early story of the GLASS universe that has yet to be revealed.

This time, we're supporting multiple languages so that more fans can enjoy it.
(We've enlisted the help of AI, so please let us know if you find any weird translations!)

Thank you for your continued support and interest.

We look forward to your purchases for the development of the Glass World series. 

-TSB
